verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents per-key concurrency limits defined with CEL expressions, such as premium users running 10 workflows at once while others run one. It also supports shared concurrency rules that cap several workflows together per user, and queue-depth strategies (CANCEL_QUEUED_EXCEPT_NEWEST/OLDEST) per concurrency key. A dedicated Rate Limits docs page exists, so the core of keeping one hot customer from starving the rest is delivered. missing for 10: substantive evidence of how rate limits work (only the page title is cited), explicit evidence of per-tenant isolation beyond per-key, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fairness under load.
